description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST emitted on transition to REQUESTING carries Option 53 (Message Type) (RFC 2131 §3 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Same mandatory Option 53 rule as PROTOCOL_02, but applied to REQUEST. Option 53 value=3 marks it as a REQUEST. Every DHCP message — DISCOVER, REQUEST, RELEASE, etc. — needs it.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER.
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • options blob contains Option 53 with value=3 (REQUEST)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST's options blob contains Option 53.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_missing_message_type — Option 53 missing from REQUEST

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
